description: Yes on 3: Allow Congressional Redistricting in MarylandEarlier this month, the Maryland General Assembly held a special session to consider a constitutional amendment on how congressional redistricting should be handled. The purpose of this constitutional amendment is to ensure that Maryland has the same ability as other states to pass a congressional redistricting plan under applicable federal laws.
